About ForgetAI 🧠

ForgetAI is a next-generation concept exploring whether artificial intelligence should not only learn — but also forget.

🚀 The Problem

Modern AI systems store massive amounts of data indefinitely. This leads to overfitting, bias accumulation, and privacy concerns.

💡 Our Idea

Inspired by human cognition, ForgetAI introduces controlled forgetting, where irrelevant or sensitive information fades over time.

⚖️ Ethical Impact

The system aligns with the “Right to be Forgotten” principle, ensuring user data is not permanently stored.

🔮 Future Vision

We believe the future of AI is not perfect memory — but intelligent memory management.
